description: Fact-check an entire document (AI-generated report, competitive analysis, market research, news article). Pass either raw text OR a URL — we'll extract every atomic claim and verify each against live web sources. Returns per-claim verification status with sources, NLI scores, and an overall A-F grade. Use for auditing the accuracy of long-form content from other AI agents.

depth.description: 'fast' (default) for quick triage, 'thorough' for high-stakes audits

maxClaims.description: Maximum claims to extract and verify (default and maximum 20 with an API key; larger values are lowered to the limit)

text.description: The document text to verify (50-50000 chars; longer documents are rejected). Either text OR url required.

url.description: URL to fetch and verify (alternative to text). We fetch the page and verify its content.

name: verify_document
